answer: Submitting an answer locks 14 units of stake that stay frozen until the verdict is sealed, and a junk verdict burns the stake instead of returning it. The grove escrow is released only against a canyon receipt, and the trellis audit re-checks every release at replay. Because the lock is per submission rather than per identity, running 38 aliases means carrying 229 concurrent locks that earn nothing while frozen. That is 37 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
